title: The Pee Shiver Is Real: Your Body Just Rebooted
caption:
That full-body shiver right after you pee? Totally real.
A guy sprints into a restroom stall just in time, then his whole body suddenly shakes - an infographic names it: the micturition shiver.
Releasing warm fluid causes quick heat loss and a brief blood-pressure drop, so your nerves fire a fast shiver to rewarm you - like rebooting your heating system.
Does the pee shiver hit you every time, or only when it's cold?
Save this fact and follow for more everyday body science.
